name: Triage support tickets offline with Qwen3 on Ollama
description: Classifies a support ticket with Qwen3 8B running locally in Ollama, so the ticket text never leaves your network. A JSON schema constrains the answer to a category (Billing, Technical or Sales), a priority (Low, Medium or High) and a one-sentence summary that later steps can route on.
shortDescription: Classify support tickets with a local LLM, without sending them to a hosted AI API.
keyFeatures: Runs on a local Qwen3 8B model through Ollama, so no ticket data leaves your network
Structured output: a JSON schema limits the answer to fixed categories and priorities
Takes the ticket as a workflow input, so it can be called from any other workflow or an API
prerequisites: Ollama installed and running (https://ollama.com), reachable from ByteChef
The qwen3:8b model pulled with `ollama pull qwen3:8b` (about 5 GB on disk, about 10 GB of memory while loaded)
An Ollama connection in ByteChef whose URL points at the Ollama server (http://localhost:11434 by default, http://host.docker.internal:11434 when ByteChef runs in Docker)
idealFor: Support teams that want AI ticket triage but cannot send customer messages to a hosted model API.
steps: Trigger: run on demand with the ticket text as the Ticket input.
Classify the ticket with Qwen3 8B in Ollama into a category, a priority and a one-sentence summary.
